title: Four-layer runner and scorecard vector
description:
Four-layer runner emitting a scorecard vector: mentions, repository-level data items, components, data flows. Raw hits are diagnostic output with no headline weight.

No cross-layer scalar is published. Occurrences, repository entities, components and edges are not commensurate units, and mentions and data items derive from the same `matchPiiSignalsInFiles` pass — data items are a `GROUP BY` over the mention stream, not a second observation — so any average would weight one regex twice. Totals are denominator-weighted within a layer only. Gates operate per layer.
